title: Leftover hug charge sits within 1/L of the mechanical integral
statement: On leftover (L, o_min(L)) at the certified reduced base, the hug (equivalently IET-prefix) charge-per-letter satisfies C_L <= C_*(n') + 1/L, where C_* is the Laplace integral (1/ln 3) ∫_1^3 n^{1-t} t^{-2} dt. This would be Denjoy-Koksma for Var(f)<1 and would make the 18 walk-charge kills DP-free.
mathematical_domain: Juggler cycle finance / exponent-walk optimal control
tested_range: committed 19-row walk-charge survey at floor 26254995; hug C versus IET prefix versus C_* at each leftover's own n'
counterexamples: L=180467: (C_hug - C_*)L = 1.868 > 1; IET prefix gives the same constant to 10^{-12}
notes: Seeds satisfy +1/L with constant 0.333 (Euler-Maclaurin size). The failure is the rotation at family offsets, not a hug-versus-IET budget dump. Trial envelopes C_*+1/(2L) and C_*+1/(2L)+u_L/L cover only 7/19. The crude bound C < 1/(ln 3 ln n') still holds on all 19 leftovers and was already recorded by walk-exchange; it is not promoted here. Uniform B/theta<1 at a fixed floor stays false. Not a halt theorem.
